LESSON: COMPOSITE MATERIALS (IDENTIFY COMPOSITE MATERIALS, COMPOSITION OF COMPOSITE MATERIALS, USES OF COMPOSITE MATERIALS)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT ENGLISH
Strand: Materials for production
Topic 3.1: Composite materials (identify composite materials, composition of composite materials, uses of composite materials)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Composite materials (identify composite materials, composition of composite materials, uses of composite materials), part of Materials for production in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8 FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can composite materials be identified? 2. Why are composite materials important to society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign of terms used for composite materials,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Composite materials (identify composite materials, composition of composite materials, uses of composite materials) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Composite materials (identify composite materials, composition of composite materials, uses of composite materials) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Composite materials (identify composite materials, composition of composite materials, uses of composite materials) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: The learner acquires team working skills when discussing the constituent materials of

composites in groups.

● Digital literacy: The learner demonstrates interactive with technology skills when using digital devices to search for

information on the composition of composite materials.

Values:
● Social justice: The learner is democratic when discussing the constituent materials of the composites.

● Peace: The learner has respect for diversity when visiting workplaces in the locality to explore the uses of composite

materials.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Internet safety and security: The learner avoids harmful or illegal content when using digital media to search for

information on the composition of composite materials

● Learner support: The learner improves ability to manage time when visiting workplaces in the locality to explore the uses

of composite materials

Link to other subjects:

● Integrated science: The learner is able to apply the knowledge of waste management as they visit a nearby workplace to

explore the uses of composite materials.

44

● KSL: The learners apply the signing skills as they fingerspell and sign key terms used for composite materials.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Print and non-print media.

● Digital resources.

● Charts of composite materials.

● Concrete, bricks, manufactured boards, stone, papier-mâché and plastic-coated paper
